message.content: {"rules":["self must be valid for both reads and writes.","self must be properly aligned, even if T has size 0.","self must be nonnull, even if T has size 0.","The value pointed to by self must be valid for dropping and uphold any additional invariants required by its type.","While drop_in_place is executing, parts of the value pointed to by self may be accessed only through the &mut self references supplied to the Drop::drop methods it invokes.","If T is not Copy, using the pointed-to value after calling drop_in_place can cause undefined behavior; assigning through *self counts as a use because it drops the value again.","write() may be used to overwrite the pointed-to data after drop_in_place without dropping it again.","drop_in_place may be used to drop pinned data when T is not repr(packed); pinned data must not be moved before it is dropped."]}
